reviewType: Sunwheel Mill final modular-map integration iPad original still-image visual review
identityClarification: dev.6fa54c5e65 is the verification record source fingerprint; dev.local is the parent-confirmed literal Simulator Info.plist build identifier.
summary: All five restoration states were inspected in both iPad orientations, plus the five rotation/native-clear frames and final landscape action frame.
The outlet remains closed at 75% and opens with onward golden light only at 100%. The payoff remains visible above portrait result UI and beside landscape result UI.
Living-light pieces preserve clear silhouettes, glow edges and size differences against the starfield and perimeter. Native-clear frames show readable committed scores and feedback after rotation.
Detailed mill, stone terraces, bridge, lanterns and workshop construction persists throughout the sequence. No center-clearing mask, cloud seam or rectangular background fade was observed.
HUD, dialogue and result action labels remain readable and contained. The upstream dialogue reading panel is visibly separate UI below remaining pieces, not a background-clearing mask.
nonBlockingObservations: Landscape crops the extreme top vane tip; the wheel identity and restoration state remain clear.
The portrait score overlaps the top vane without making the score unreadable.
The lowest-left amber piece overlaps warm foliage in portrait while retaining its luminous outline.
The last two landscape 100% captures are byte-identical; 16 exports contain 15 unique images.
limitations: This bounded map-integration rerun contains partial boards and rotation/native-clear captures, not 49-piece dense-board captures. It does not independently renew earlier dense-board acceptance.
The 100% milestone frames show result composition; a real terminal-win action is not inferred solely from those stills. Native interaction evidence comes from the parent-owned passing test.
Static screenshots establish only appearance at captured instants, not motion quality, timing or absence of transient issues.
Development Simulator evidence only; no physical installation or actual VoiceOver review is claimed.
Every original PNG was opened with view_image. Tool display resizing did not modify retained bytes; original EXIF orientation, dimensions and hashes were verified without edits.
